repos_data.description: Local code intelligence for developers and AI agents. Connect code, docs and infrastructure in a persistent graph, with CBM Lens, MCP tools, agent integrations and change-aware test selection.
Codebase intelligence for AI and humans: code health scores, auto-generated docs, git analytics, dead code detection, and architectural decisions via MCP.
Framework-aware code intelligence MCP server — 91 framework integrations, 81 languages, 72.7% fewer input tokens to review a pull request, comprehension at parity
MCP server that orchestrates language servers into agent-native workflows. 65 tools, 30 CI-verified languages.
Code intelligence for AI assistants - MCP server, CLI, and HTTP API with symbol navigation, impact analysis, and architecture mapping

Roslyn-based MCP server giving AI agents deep semantic understanding of .NET/C# codebases — 67 tools for navigation, call graphs, diagnostics & code fixes, safe refactoring, code-quality auditing, test intelligence, DI graphs, and IL/external-assembly inspection.

Codebase Context gives AI agents understanding of your codebase through semantic code search, team conventions, patterns, and memory, so they use fewer tokens, spend less time, and produce better, more familiar output.

Deep code indexing MCP server for AI agents. 25 tools: hybrid FTS5 + embedding search, call graphs, git blame/hotspots, build system analysis. Multi-repo workspaces, GPU-accelerated semantic search, 10 languages via tree-sitter. Fully local, zero cloud dependencies.
Local-first MCP server that gives coding agents structured context packets, code/schema facts, and diagnostics - backed by a local SQLite store.
MCP server providing semantic Java code analysis for AI agents. Built on Eclipse JDT with tools for navigation, refactoring, search, and metrics.
AI Coders search blindly. Be their guide.
A local MCP server for cross-repository semantic code intelligence in TypeScript and Go, backed by a persistent LadybugDB graph.
Open-source MCP server and hook service that keeps Claude Code and Codex engineering context current as the code changes, and holds edits whose evidence changed.

Self-maintaining and persistent codebase memory for AI coding agents — a deterministic AST index plus agent-written notes that flag themselves stale when the code changes. Works with Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex via MCP + CLI.
MCP server for GDScript semantic analysis via Godot's built-in language server

LayerMap MCP: a layered map of your codebase for coding agents: callers, callees and the impact of a change, for TypeScript, JavaScript, Go, Python and Java. MCP server, CLI, and plugins for Claude Code and Codex.

Free, 100% local MCP server. Turns your codebase into an AST knowledge graph so AI coding agents (Claude, Cursor, Copilot) get exact caller trees, semantic search, and safe writes — 60% fewer tokens, zero data egress.
Local-first MCP runtime for coding agents with bounded filesystem access, safe writes, AST search, LSP navigation, and Git tooling.
Deterministic code map for AI coding agents: a tree-sitter symbol and call graph served over MCP and a CLI, with no embeddings, network or telemetry.
Local-first code graph + context engine for AI coding agents (Rust/MCP server). Published in microsoft/winget-pkgs (winget install halloffame12.CTX) & awesome-mcp-servers. A+ on Glama.
